import statistics

# Cumulative seigniorage on silver and minor coins (from bulletins)
# Source: October 1939 bulletin (page 62) - authoritative for September data
cumulative = {
    'June': 73.4,
    'July': 74.7,
    'August': 76.1,
    'September': 80.1
}

# Calculate monthly increases (month-over-month change in cumulative)
july_increase = cumulative['July'] - cumulative['June']
august_increase = cumulative['August'] - cumulative['July']
september_increase = cumulative['September'] - cumulative['August']

print('Monthly increases in seigniorage:')
print(f'  July 1939:     {cumulative[\"July\"]} - {cumulative[\"June\"]} = {july_increase}')
print(f'  August 1939:   {cumulative[\"August\"]} - {cumulative[\"July\"]} = {august_increase}')
print(f'  September 1939: {cumulative[\"September\"]} - {cumulative[\"August\"]} = {september_increase}')

# Values for z-score calculation
values = [july_increase, august_increase, september_increase]
print(f'\\nValues for z-score: {values}')

# Z-score uses population standard deviation (dividing by n)
mean = statistics.mean(values)
pstdev = statistics.pstdev(values)

print(f'Mean: {mean}')
print(f'Population stdev: {pstdev}')

# Z-score = (value - mean) / stdev
z_score = (september_increase - mean) / pstdev
print(f'\\nZ-score = ({september_increase} - {mean}) / {pstdev} = {z_score}')

# Round to nearest hundredths
z_rounded = round(z_score, 2)
print(f'Z-score rounded to hundredths: {z_rounded}')

# Check if unusual (threshold z > 1.96)
is_unusual = z_rounded > 1.96
print(f'\\nThreshold: 1.96')
print(f'{z_rounded} > 1.96? {is_unusual}')
print(f'Classification: {\"unusual\" if is_unusual else \"normal\"}')

# Final answer
answer = f'[{z_rounded}, {\"unusual\" if is_unusual else \"normal\"}]'
print(f'\\nFinal answer: {answer}')
"
